synthesis.description: A trader, scheduler or pipeline contact asks the data or facility team to set up new pooling, storage or delivery points and combinations, re-map a zone, change a pipe code, zero confirmed nominations or remove meters from an estimate. The facility team enters the change in Global Facilities or the scheduling system, sometimes only after authorization from the desk lead, and confirms it back, often naming who is assigned the meter. Some rounds need extra data gathered first, such as State and County details for a list of meters.
steps: A requester emails a list of points, meters or mappings to create, change or retire.
Missing reference data, such as State and County for listed meters, is gathered from colleagues.
Where needed, the change is authorized by the responsible desk lead.
The facility team sets up or changes the record in Global Facilities or the scheduling system.
Related records are adjusted, such as deferred delivery points, nominations or estimates.
The team confirms the set-up and names the person assigned to the meter.
synthesis.approach: A standard set-up request form capturing point type, pipeline, zone, mapping, State and County, effective date and approver, validated against the facility master before entry, with an automatic confirmation naming the assigned scheduler.
synthesis.rationale: Requests arrive as free-text lists of differing shape and sometimes lack the data needed to set up a point. A fixed request layout gets complete, approved requests to the facility team the first time and makes entry largely mechanical.
